Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh were never in this to be honest. Right from the first ball. It's evident from the fact that they only managed to get three wickets, with two coming in the final over of the innings. Rubel Hossain was the standout bowler, having picked up 2 wickets for just 27 runs in his 4-over spell, while Nazmul Islam was good as well. The rest weren't quite up to the mark and leaked runs. The run chase won't be easy now, despite the wicket known to ease out for the batters as the game progresses. Let's see how it unfolds. Join us in a short while.

The Men in Blue have a more than satisfactory total on the board. Being put into bat and given the wicket, they needed a good start and that's what they got. Questions were raised about Rohit Sharma's form and today he came out to prove everyone wrong. Make no mistake, he struggled, but he toughened it out there and eventually started to middle it towards the end. He first formed a 70-run stand with Shikhar Dhawan to set the tone, then blew the Tigers away with Suresh Raina, who came in and thwarted the bowlers without wasting any time. The century stand with Raina, in which Rohit almost got to his ton, was enough to propel them past the 170-mark and be in a comfortable position.

OUT! Rohit Sharma is run out! Misses out on a ton and this is an excellent over from Rubel Hossain. Conceded just 4 off it. Full on off, Rohit smashes it hard back to him. Rubel stops it, and since it's the last ball of the over, the batsmen run. This allows the bowler to run back and take the bails off. Rohit is out but it's been a superb knock to say the least from him. INDIA FINISH ON 176/3!
Superb ball. Beautiful delivery as Rubel spears it in the blockhole. Karthik jams it out through to sweeper cover and takes one.
Stifled appeal, but the inside edge has saved Sharma there. Inswinging yorker on middle and leg, the batsman swings and gets an edge onto his pads before taking the run.
Quite full, swinging in, smacked down to long on by going deep inside the crease. Karthik is off the mark.
Short of a good length angling in, hits Sharma on the body as he misses his pull. A leg bye is taken as the ball falls on the off side.
Dinesh Karthik to walk in next to bat.

OUT! Suresh Raina just misses out on his fifty! Bit unfortunate, played exceptionally well, fully deserved it. But, he's done his job nonetheless. Full on the pads, Raina lofts it over mid-wicket. Not enough distance on this one as it's into the hands of Soumya Sarkar who takes it after moving to his left.
Rubel Hossain to bowl the last over of the innings.
Fuller from Rahman, Raina gets it off the inner half while trying to swing to square leg. One run to end the over. 11 runs off the over.
Skips down the track to get close to the pitch and hits it down the ground for a single.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for the Indian captain! The 100-run stand between these two comes up with that as well. Fine hit by Rohit Sharma. Full toss outside off, he opens the face and runs it down to the third man boundary.
FOUR! Full toss with width on offer outside off, Rohit walks a step across, swings and scythes it over point for a boundary.
Mistimed pull to this short ball, down to long on for a single.
Takes Raina by surprise with the bumper. Well directed, no shot offered by the batsman.

SIX! Rohit Sharma, you beautiful, beautiful man! Speechless at this. His power hitting is just something else. High full toss, not enough for the umpire to signal a no ball. Rohit swings hard across the line and it's high into the night sky. Has the height and the distance as well as it clears the mid-wicket boundary with ease.
In the blockhole from Abu Hider, it's driven down to long on for one.

SIX! Raina's been immaculate since he's walked out in the middle. This isn't that short, but he still takes on the pull off the front foot. Swings hard and sends it sailing over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Good comeback from the bowler. Fires in a yorker on middle stump, Rohit digs it out off the inside edge past the leg stump behind. One run taken.

SIX! Another big one for Rohit Sharma! Right off the meat. Short ball angling in from around the wicket, the opener stands tall and takes on the pull. Connects well and muscles the pull over mid-wicket for half a dozen.
Just back of a length outside off, slashed to point. One run added to the total.
Abu Hider Rony is back.
Shorter on off, the southpaw backs away and places the punch to sweeper cover for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.

SIX! Might be struggling, but he's connected this one really well. Full ball on the pads, Sharma kneels down and brings out the slog sweep. Dumps it over square leg and into the stands, where a spectator manages to take the catch. Nicely done, good man. Maybe the Tigers could have used him on the field.
Just behind a length, punched away through towards sweeper cover for one.
FOUR! Beautiful! He's such a delight to watch when he's in full flow. Short ball just outside off, Raina cuts this over short third man and picks up a boundary.

Cutter on leg, Sharma looks to flick it away through mid-wicket but instead spoons a leading edge to long off. Easy single taken. Unable to middle it, Rohit. He's had to work hard for his knock so far. Hanging in there, which probably is the most important part given Raina is hitting them well.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl again.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short in length once again, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mistimed shot but no harm done. Rohit comes down the track, goes for the big hoick but can't connect properly. Plays it down towards wide long on and rotates strike.
Spinning away from around the off stick, knocked to the long off fielder for a single.

FOUR! And the 50-stand is up! Brought up in superb style by Raina. Dropped short, he goes deep inside his crease, positions himself well for the pull and executes the placement to perfection as he beats the two men out in the deep to the mid-wicket fence.
Starts off from around the wicket and darts it across the right-hander. Rohit Sharma waits for it before he cuts it square on the off side for a run.
Mahmudullah brings himself into the bowling attack.
Brings the wrists into play as he turns this through wide mid on. The man in the deep cuts it off and keeps the batsmen to two. Good over for the Indians, 13 runs off this one.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Suresh Raina! He picked this up perfectly. Expected the yorker to come, so he leaned ahead and just lofted it over mid on for a boundary.

FOUR! Edged and away! Short ball banged in, Raina clears his front leg and takes on the pull, but gets a top edge over the keeper's head. Mustafizur from fine leg comes across to cut it off, but his sloppy effort allows the ball to go through him and away to the fence behind.
Makes sweet connection but unfortunately for Raina, it's straight to the fielder. He backs away to the full swinging ball and drives, finds extra cover though.
Right in the blockhole. Good delivery, but equally well played by the Indian captain. He digs it out down to long on and takes just the one this time.
Attempted yorker which misses, ends up becoming a low full toss. Rohit hits it down the ground, towards long on and gets a double for it.
Rubel Hossain back into the attack.
Straighter one on off, takes the inside edge of Raina's bat and thuds onto his pads.
Stays back to this one spinning away from around off and plays it to point.
FOUR! That's blasted away! Raina holding nothing back on that. He dances down the track, gets close to the pitch and hammers it straight back down the ground for a boundary.
SIX! Connects this one to perfection! BANG! Tossed right up there by Hasan, Raina gets down to this one and slog sweeps it high and handsome over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Could have got out there. Raina is taken by surprise by the lack of pace on the ball. He checks his shot and almost spoons a catch to short extra cover.
Quicker through the air and attacking the stumps, it's hit aerially down to long on by Rohit Sharma for one run.
Mehidy Hasan comes back on to bowl.
Sharma leans ahead to this fuller length ball and eases it to long off to retain strike.
Hangs back and offers a firm punch through the covers for one more.
Fifty for Rohit Sharma! His 13th in this format and a much-deserved one. He needed this. He comes down the track and hits it through covers.
FOUR! That's a very good shot from the Indian skipper! Too full from the left armer, Rohit is able to get low to it and sweep it over short fine leg for a scintillating boundary.
Over the wicket now, fuller outside off, Suresh Raina drills it square through point and crosses over.
Full toss from around the wicket, Rohit hits this down the ground towards long on for a single.
Abu Hider Rony returns to the attack.
Cutting back in from around off, on a good length, goes off Raina's pads and falls on the off side. Dot ball to end the over.
Down the leg side this time, pulled straight to short fine leg. The batsmen take off quickly and complete the run.
Short of a good length on the body, worked away through square leg for a couple of runs.
Shaping away from around off, on a back of a length, possibly a slower one too. Rohit looks to run it down to third man for a single but can't connect.
Darts this extremely full, on the stumps. Rohit Sharma walks out of his crease and plays it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery on off stump, Raina walks across, comes down the track as well and works it to mid-wicket for a brisk single.
Mustafizur Rahman is back into the attack.
Works it through mid-wicket for a brace. 9 runs from this over but end of a good spell by Islam. His figures read, 4-0-27-0.
SIX! A much needed one for India! Sharma comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and sends it sailing over the mid-wicket fence. This should break the shackles now.
Floats it up on off, kept out.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Tosses it up on off, defended.
A full toss, a gift for Raina. He though is surprised by it as he hits it back to the bowler.

Raina almost got dismissed off his first ball! He gets a ball down the leg side, Raina flicks it uppishly towards fine leg. The fielder there has to make up his mind quickly whether to go for the catch or not. He does not go for it and it lands on the bounce. He should have take a chance there, he might have got to it.
Suresh Raina is the next man in.

OUT! A CORKER OF A YORKER! What a delivery by Rubel Hussain. That dropped catch has not cost Bangladesh a lot. Liton Das will surely be breathing a sigh of a relief here. Rubel comes steaming in and bowls an effort delivery. A yorker to be precise and also gets it to tail away from leg stump. Dhawan plays all around it and misses it to see his middle stump get knocked out. A brilliant sight for the bowler and a much-needed wicket for the bowling side. They have broken the 70-run stand. It has also been a good phase for them and they would now look to build on it.
Nicely bowled! Full and tailing back in. Sharma hits it down to long on for a run.
Slower ball outside off, Dhawan goes for the heave but does not time it as it goes towards mid-wicket for a run.
Shortish on middle, pulled towards short mid-wicket.

Rohit tries to take him on by coming down the track. He though gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls towards the keeper and the batsmen set off for a run. The keeper has a shy at his end but misses.
Rubel Hossain is back on.
Darts it on middle, driven back to the bowler. A dot to finish, a good tight over by the bowler. His figures read, 3-0-18-0.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Tosses it up on off, Rohit tries to push it down the ground but gets an outside edge towards short third man.
Fires it on middle, Dhawan flicks it towards short fine leg for a run. Mushfiqur Rahim behind the stumps makes a huge appeal but he is the only one doing so.
Gives it air on off, worked against the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Slower through the air on off, Dhawan reverse sweeps it through point for a run.
Ends the over with a dot! Fuller on off, stroked to covers.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Eases it down to long on for a run.
Down the leg side and the umpire calls it a wide.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Just a little short by the bowler. Dhawan picks the length up early and pulls it through square leg and the ball races away.
Tosses it up on off, driven down to long on for a run.
Mehidy Hasan is back on.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
A huge appeal! Dhawan goes for the sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head. The impact was outside off and more importantly, it hit the glove first.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.

DROPPED AND FOUR! That has been horribly misjudged by Liton Das! Dhawan comes down the track and tries to go big over the leg side. He however, only gets elevation but no distance. It goes towards deep mid-wicket where Das does not judge it and then dives to his right with his hand stretched out. He gets his hand to it but can't hang on. To add salt to the wounds, it rolls away for a boundary. A reprieve for Dhawan, he has been in form, how costly will this prove?
Floats it up on off, worked towards mid-wicket.
Tosses it up on off, driven through mid off for a run. 50 up for India.
Nazmul Islam is back on.
FOUR! Dhawan takes full toll of it! A full ball on off, Shikhar lofts it over the mid off fielder for a boundary. A good Powerplay for India, they are 49 for no loss.
Dot ball! On a length around off, pushed towards mid off. 7 from 5. Last ball of the Powerplay coming up.
Shortish on middle, Sharma stands tall and pulls it off the middle but straight to deep square leg for a run.
Good bowling! He sees Dhawan giving him the charge and bowls a slower one on middle. Dhawan adjusts and guides it towards point for a run.
Shortish on off, guided towards point for a run.

FOUR! Full points to the bowler there but runs for the batsman. A slower ball which completely deceives Rohit. He tries to force it through the off side but gets an outside edge through the vacant slip cordon for a boundary.
Abu Hider Rony is back into the attack. He will bowl the last over of the Powerplay.
Very full and wide outside off, Rohit squeezes it through point. Liton Das gives it a chase and saves a run for his team.
Darts it full on middle, Sharma hits it back from where it came.
SIX! BANG GOES ROHIT! Hasan tosses it up and pays the price. Rohit goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Comes down the track and yorks himself. Rohit jams it out to the bowler.
Shorter on off, pushed down to long off for a single.
Fires it on the stumps, pushed down to long on for a run.
Mehidy Hasan is into the attack now.

SIX! No, he can't! What a hit, son! Dhawan comes down the track, expecting a slower one and he gets it. He sends it sailing over the bowler's head and he has hit it well enough for it to go all the way. First of the game.

Good bowling this! Once again hits the length around middle, bowls the cutter. Sharma can't do a lot with it as he just taps it towards mid off for a quick run. Just three singles of this over so far. Can he finish it well?
Good length on middle, cramping Dhawan for room. He eases it down to mid on and takes a single.
Shorter in length outside off, Dhawan tries to pierce the gap between short third man and point but hits it straight to the fielder in the latter position.
On a length around off, kept out.
On the pads, worked around the corner for a run.
Mustafizur Rahman is into the attack.
FOUR! Trademark Dhawan! Full and on off, a half-volley. Too easy for Dhawan as he leans into it and times it through covers to end the over with a boundary.

In the air... but just out of reach! Rohit almost bagged another failure. Rubel lands it on a length around middle, Sharma tries to go over the top but mistimes it completely. It goes uppishly over the bowler's head and there are two fielders converging for it, one from mid on and the other from mid off. Rony from the former position goes for it with a full stretch dive but can't reach it. A run taken by the batsmen.
Walks down the track and makes it a full toss. He though could not time it as it was bowled at a good pace. It goes towards mid off and the batsmen take a run.
Good effort delivery on off, it zips off the surface. Dhawan could only guide it to point. He sets off for a run but is sent back.
Back of a length on off, Rohit guides it through backward point. He runs the first one hard but Mustafizur in the deep does well to keep it to one.
Length ball on the stumps, Rohit keeps it out.
Rubel Hossain is into the attack.

FOUR! Second of the over! A good way to get off the mark for Dhawan. Short and down the leg side, this is the bowler's sixth consecutive short delivery. Dhawan goes on the back foot and paddle sweeps it very fine towards the fine leg fence. 9 runs from this over. A poor over by the spinner, could have been hit for more.
Flatter but on the shorter side, pushed down to long off to change strike.
Drags his length back outside off, Sharma cuts it hard but straight to the point fielder. He should have put that away as there was width on offer also.
Shortish on off, cut towards point. Rohit wanted a run but is rightly sent back by Dhawan.
FOUR! First of the match! Very slow and on the shorter side on the stumps. Rohit Sharma has all the time in the world to rock back and whip it through wide mid on for a boundary.
Slower through the air on off, Sharma who is quite watchful guides it to point.
Nazmul Islam will bowl the second over.
Another slower ball on off, defended to point. A couple off the first over, a good one by the bowler.
Sharma is off the mark! He taps this length ball on off, towards cover for a quick run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller in length on off, Sharma defends it.
WIDE! First run for India and it is courtesy an extra. Short and wide outside off, Rohit walks ahead and tries to cut but misses it.

A good second delivery. The bowler comes running in and bowls it on a length around off, it comes back in sharply. Sharma is done in by the swing and tries to defend it with bat close to pad. The Bangladeshis make a muted appeal but the umpire stays put. Replays however, show it was pad first. It would have been close had the fielding side taken a review.
The left armer starts around the wicket and bowls it short, a slower one outside off. Rohit goes after it but mistimes it to cover-point. It was a loosener but Rohit could not make full use of it.

We are done and dusted with the national anthems and now we are all set for the first ball to get underway. Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan will open the batting for the Indians. Abu Hider Rony will bowl the first over for Bangladesh. He has a slip in place. Here we go...
The players are out for their respective national anthems. The Indians will sing their first followed by the Bangladeshis.
India (Playing XI) - Rohit Sharma(c), Shikhar Dhawan, Lokesh Rahul, Suresh Raina, Manish Pandey, Dinesh Karthik(w), Vijay Shankar, Washington Sundar, Shardul Thakur, Mohammed Siraj, Yuzvendra Chahal.
Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal, Soumya Sarkar, Liton Das, Mushfiqur Rahim(w), Mahmudullah(c), Sabbir Rahman, Mehidy Hasan, Rubel Hossain, Abu Hider Rony, Mustafizur Rahman, Nazmul Islam.

Indian skipper, Rohit Sharma, says they would have batted first as they want to prepare for both the situations. He feels the wicket is not going to change a lot and he hopes they bat well. He is happy with the way his team performed in the last game, both with the ball and the bat. Admits it is a new game and they have to start from scratch. (On his own form) He adds he just has to spend a little time in the middle but the performance of the team matters more. States he wants to lead by example but unfortunately he has been lackluster till now. Informs they have one change as Mohammed Siraj comes in for Jaydev Unadkat.

Bangladesh skipper, Mahmudullah, says the wicket looks dry. He feels the spinners might come into play and thy would look to use the condition. Reckons the wicket gets better as the game progresses. Informs they motivated themselves before the chase in the last game and they are looking forward for this game. Ends by saying they have one change for today as Abu Hider Rony comes in for Taskin Ahmed.
Toss - Bangladesh win the toss and they opt to bowl first.

PITCH REPORT - Brett Lee says there is no light grass on the surface. Informs there are a couple of cracks which have started to open up in the good length area. Further adds it is a lot drier and mentions it is the third time the wicket has been used. Reckons there will be something for the fast bowlers and later on, there will be something for the spinners. He feels 170-180 will be a good score on this wicket.

India on the other hand, are back to regular business after a surprise defeat in the first game. After two back-to-back victories, they will look to seal their spot in the final with a win here. Their players are firing on all cylinders and Rohit Sharma will hope for the same. The last time these two sides met, we saw a lop-sided affair with the Men in Blue coming out victorious. One though would predict a better show from the Bangladeshis tonight. Let us hope for an equal display between bat and ball. Stay tuned for the toss and the line-ups.

Hello and welcome to the 5th game of the Tri-Series in Sri Lanka between India and Bangladesh. We are now at the business end of the tournament with India sitting at the top of the table and the Bangla Tigers down at the bottom. The latter now can't afford any slip-ups as it would further dent their chances of making it to the finals. They though will be high in confidence heading into this game as they are coming on the back of a brilliant performance. However, their bowling is an issue and they might make some changes to their bowling attack.
